turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Hope you're having a good Monday. How are you feeling these days? Fully back in the swing of things after recovering from that flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling 100% back to normal, thank goodness. I'm actually getting ready for my ER shift tonight. Just about to walk out the door to catch the late-night city bus to the hospital.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Glad to hear you're fully recovered! The late-night transit can be a quiet time to prepare yourself for a busy ER shift. Do you usually read or listen to something on the ride over?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I usually listen to something lighthearted. Tonight I've got a hilarious show queued up where a couple of comedians break down ridiculous news stories. It definitely keeps me laughing before the stress of the hospital starts.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A comedy show sounds like the perfect pre-shift stress reliever! A good laugh does wonders. Have you had any time for your hobbies lately, like sourdough baking, or is work keeping you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually baked a fresh sourdough boule yesterday! The Phoenix heat makes the dough rise incredibly fast, so I have to be really careful with the proofing times, but it turned out great.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, I bet the Arizona summer heat makes sourdough rising a high-stakes game! Did you and Tom get to enjoy some of it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We did! We had some of it toasted. Tom loved it. He's actually planning on driving me home in the morning so I don't have to take the bus back after a long night.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's incredibly sweet of him! Saving you that morning trip is a great way to support your schedule. How has the ER been lately? Is the summer heat bringing in more dehydration cases?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, definitely. Phoenix summers always mean a surge of heat-related issues in the ER. We've been staying very busy keeping everyone hydrated and stable.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can only imagine. You and the rest of the night staff do such vital work keeping everyone safe. I hope tonight's shift goes as smoothly as possible for you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks so much! I appreciate it. I'm arriving at my stop now, so I'll talk to you tomorrow. Have a great night!
